notes.title: Hotjoin and Save Games
notes.content:
[p]Hello adventurers,[/p][p] We’re excited to share the next major update with you: [b]Hotjoin and Save Games! 🥳🔥💯[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Hotjoin ✨[/h2][p]With Hotjoin, you can now [b]join an ongoing party[/b] via room code, quick join, or a Steam friend invite (the latter only works if you haven’t started the Wild Woods yet or are still in the main menu). After choosing one of those options, you pick your skin and a role. Afterwards, you'll see the others, and with one more click, [b]jump straight into the adventure[/b] 🐯🌲🦁[/p][p]We know connecting [i]may[/i] still be tricky for some, but this feature should already add value to your gaming experience 🤗 We’re also planning to add Hotjoin to local games in the future, which will require a different system.[/p][p][/p][h2]Save Games ⏹️😴▶️[/h2][p]From now on, every time you [b]leave camp[/b], your run will be [b]saved automatically.[/b] When you load the game, you’ll [b]start right after camp[/b]. The save file will be deleted once you finish the run (win or lose).[/p][p]If you play as a group, everyone gets their own save file. You can continue your run with the same team, with others, or even solo. In the future, we’d like saves to happen when entering camp, but that will require changes to world generation.[/p][p][/p][h2]Group Management 👥[/h2][p]The host can now kick players and block them from the current run, preventing anyone from repeatedly trying to rejoin.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][u]Official Patchnotes 0.2.0[/u][/h2][p][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p]Hot Join Feature: It is now possible to join games that are already in progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Friend Invite: It is now possible to join a game played by friends or be invited to one via Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Save Feature: Every time you leave a camp, your game progress will now be saved. You can continue playing these saved games both online and offline. The saved game will be automatically deleted once a round has been completed. [/p][/*][*][p]Group Management: The host can now remove players from your current session and change the visibility of the session while playing.[/p][/*][*][p]New network option entry for setting the default room visibility in network lobbies.[/p][/*][*][p]New network option entry to hide the room code in an online lobby. Useful if you want to stream your game.[/p][/*][*][p]New jumping into the water and cutting gras effects.[/p][/*][*][p]New menu for selecting the player skins in the lobby.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Unified some ui elements, like popups and buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]In Safe Camp, everyone no longer has to sit around the campfire for the game to continue. Instead, a timer starts as soon as at least half of the players have gone to sleep.[/p][/*][*][p]The in-game pause menu now shows the region, room code and privacy state of the current game.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now always see the currently selected region in the online menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Obstacles along the way like treetrunks are now highlighted more clearly.[/p][/*][*][p]The boxes in the elite event now throw away resources that are lying beneath them when they land.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss upgrade rewards will now be replenished using regular upgrades when there are no special boss upgrades available.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Attention! Due to a bug in the last game version, players only took half damage on all difficulty levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Totems are now thrown out of their station when the wagon takes damage, instead of simply falling directly to the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Wagon & Rosie upgrades no longer perform their actions if the corresponding station is damaged. For example, the Turret or the Wave Defense upgrade.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Sometimes it wasn't possible for everyone to participate in the battle against the second boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing Alt F4 during gameplay caused the game to crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes enemies lost their target and simple stood still.[/p][/*][*][p]An invisible mouse cursor could still select elements on the user interface.[/p][/*][*][p]If no wagon skin was ever selected and the language was changed, an error could occur.[/p][/*][*][p]Brook, the badger boss, played his defeat sound a little too early.[/p][/*][*][p]Sid played her appearance sound a little too early.[/p][/*][*][p]Players could no longer be knockedback in the air by enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Players only took half damage on all difficulty levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]It sometimes looks like enemies are healed when hit on clients with a bad connection.[/p][/*][*][p]If you quickly navigate back in some menus when opening them, you may get stuck in the navigation. In most cases, the only solution is to restart the device.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We can't wait to see your ✨ [b]new high scores![/b] ✨ Now that you can save your game, nothing should stop you from playing endless mode [b]for hours on end! 🔥 😄[/b][/p][p]Wish you all a catastic week! 🐈‍⬛🤗💚[/p]

notes.title: DevLog August 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]we hope you’re all having a great summer! 🌞 
Since HotJoin remains our [b]top priority[/b] and keeps us busy most of the time, we’re dedicating this DevLog to the feature itself and want to share some [b]deeper insights[/b] with you:[/p][p]
[/p][h2][u]Why do things sometimes take longer than they seem?[/u][/h2][p]The [b]It's easy, you just have to add XYZ[/b] phenomenon.[/p][p]For HotJoin, we first had to find an approach that reliably works with our existing multiplayer architecture. We tried three different approaches—and only [i]the third[/i] one turned out to be viable.

[/p][h2][u]Starting point (Version 0.1.4)[/u][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/19ed3551adf4348f0c59914c0116b5984791fa8a.png"][/img][/p][p]Our game is split into multiple scenes. Before the refactor, there were essentially two: [b]a Menu scene and a Game scene[/b]. For HotJoin to make sense, we wanted players to choose their skin and role before joining.[/p][p]In 0.1.4, [b]the lobby lived in the Menu scene[/b]. When everyone was ready, all players switched at the same time to the Game scene. The game waited for everyone because loading game-relevant data happens locally on each system. In the Game scene, we then loaded the network objects—everything the cats interact with.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]First approach[/u][/h2][p][b]Keep the scenes[/b] as in 0.1.4. The host sends the necessary information on request to late joining clients who want to join from the menu.[/p][p][b]Result:[/b] Acceptable for one client. Multiple simultaneous joins led to synchronization errors between clients. On top of that, the amount of data we needed to send with this approach was too large 😥[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Second approach[/u][/h2][p]We added an [b]additional Data scene[/b] containing all important network objects that clients need for HotJoin.[/p][p][b]Result:[/b] Unfortunately, our multiplayer plugin synchronized all objects with the clients by default, which made a data scene pointless 🥲 While people were still in the lobby, you could already hear the rest of the group fighting evil badgers. The integration of Steam Friend Invites also showed that a Data scene alone would not be enough. We needed a different approach 🤔[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Third approach (0.2.0)[/u][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/a2fdd160f6e3e76213c364b82c3a4d47669934c7.png"][/img][/p][p]We [b]decoupled the Menu scene[/b] completely from the networking layer and moved skin and role selection into a [b]separate Room scene[/b]. The required network objects can be preloaded there, and late joiners can fetch all the information they need for a consistent entry.[/p][p]From approach two, we learned that while all objects are synchronized by default, you can disable synchronization for specific objects. In the room scene, we therefore only load the essential objects. Only when the countdown has expired do we synchronize the rest of the world, and the group or individual hot-joining clients switch to the game scene in a controlled manner.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Conclusion[/u][/h2][p]With the new structure — Menu → Room scene (selection & warm-up) → Game scene — we were able to [b]reduce waiting time[/b] by loading important objects before entering the room. We also now have a standardized entry path that we can target both via [b]Steam Friend Invites and save games[/b] (everyone always loads into the room first) 🥳 As they say, hindsight is 20/20. If we had known right away what wouldn't work, we would have started with the third approach 😅[/p][p]
Okay, enough talk — time to put the [b]final touches[/b] on HotJoin. You’ve been patient, and we can’t wait to get it into your hands very very soon 😲🥰🐯[/p]

And while the temperatures outside might keep climbing, we’ve got some cold views for you ❄️🥶[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/303b6e2c69f96c6ac41ca72b394a00700ef9bc5a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][u]What happens next[/u][/h1][list][*][p]Continue working on HotJoin and SaveGame[/p][/*][*][p]Continue development of the third biome[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We wish you a relaxing summer time (hopefully with a little less rain than here in Hamburg 😅)! 🌞​🍨​🏝️​[/p]

notes.title: DevLog June 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

Over the last few weeks, our main focus has been on finishing the ✨ newest update ✨ perfectly in time for the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b]. What better way to start your summer than having an adventure in the Wild Woods? 🌞​🎮​🍨​[/p][p]
[/p][h1][u]What we’ve been working on[/u][/h1][p][/p][h2][u]Update Preparation[/u] ✨[/h2][p]Our latest update went live a couple of days ago. It included six new languages, numerous bug fixes, and new visual effects 🔥 Like, did you catch how smooth it looks when you're cutting through the reeds?

This cute little splash wasn't ready in time, but it's [i]soooo adorable[/i] that we couldn't wait to show it to you! 🥰
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/9d082fdb9b1b58094d9e990bdf3c9041d2a47b5c.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2][u]Third Biome[/u] ☃️[/h2][p]Last month, we started a [url="https://discord.com/channels/599975218408194058/1377277568222236712"]Discord thread[/url] to collect your ideas for the third biome. You all came up with some [b]great[/b] suggestions! [b]Thank you so much![/b] 🙏[/p][p]The best part is that some of your ideas match ours perfectly (sometimes they're almost the same) 🙌 Seeing this is [b]super helpful[/b] for making further decisions. Therefore, we took some of those ideas, combined them, and developed them further. We've even tested some of them in a simplified version 🎮 This allows us to [b]experiment with ideas[/b] and figure out which ones could actually end up the game and which are great but can't be implemented.[/p][p]One suggestion that we explored further is how the cold could also [b]affect daytime and freeze resources[/b]. But how would you survive the cold when it's always there, and how would you gather the resources you need? 🥶❄️ So, the next step was - and still is - developing new game mechanics to help us survive this scenario.[/p][p]Furthermore, we like the idea of using snow as a [b]new interaction point[/b]: snowball fights with enemies, snowstorms as a new challenge, Rosie stuck up in the deep snow, and so on 🌨️[/p][p]We’re [b]super excited[/b] about everything that could happen in the new biome. And, of course, as soon as anything other than "it's getting cold" is set in stone, [b]you'll be the first to know! 🤗🥰[/b][/p][p]
[/p][h2][u]Updating to Unity 6[/u] 🖥️[/h2][p]It's great to have new features and optimizations that help our workflow. On the other hand, such a transfer is very time-consuming and causes new bugs 😅[/p][p]
[/p][h1][u]What happens next[/u][/h1][list][*][p]Keep working on HotJoin[/p][/*][*][p]Rework the lobby UI (mainly to improve the skin selection)[/p][/*][*][p]Continue working on the third biome[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Have a pawsome day! 🤗🥰🌞​🎮​🍨​[/p]

notes.title: DevLog May 2025
notes.content:
Meow meow,

Before we start our regular MDL, we would like to say a [b]huge thank you![/b] 🤗 We are currently working more intensively through all of your ideas and feedback shared via Discord and Steam by sorting them thematically, closing duplicate cards, and likewise.
Those cards include so many [b]great, unique, and fun ideas![/b] Thank you for putting so much effort into sharing your thoughts with us! 🥰💚


[h1][u]What we’ve been working on[/u] 🎮[/h1]

[h2][u]HotJoin[/u] [/h2]
After exploring many different approaches to implement HotJoin, we’ve finally found a solution we’re confident in 💪 It’s a more elaborate and labor-intensive method than we initially hoped for and requires partially reworking the lobby, but we’re convinced this is a solid way to go.

[h2][u]More languages[/u] 🗣️[/h2]
Translating Wild Woods into additional languages is in its final steps. With the next bigger update (which is coming soon), the following languages will be available: Ukrainian, Italian, Hungarian, Turkish, Polish, and Czech. 
You might notice that Hindi is no longer on the list. Unfortunately, we had to postpone it due to an issue with rendering glyphs correctly - one we can’t fix ourselves 😕 We're hoping a future update to the component we rely on will address this.

[h2][u]Prediction Bug Fixed[/u] 🐞​🛠️[/h2]
When playing online with poor latency, objects such as trees and bushes would be destroyed, respawned, and then destroyed again in quick succession - triggering sound and visual effects each time. We fixed the issue, and with the next update, the multiplayer experience should feel noticeably smoother 🔥

[h2][u]VFX Improvements[/u] ✨[/h2]
We also spend some time improving existing visual effects, adding new ones and fixing related bugs. This includes a new potion effect for players, a glowing outline for the herbalist's staff when it is charged, and various small improvements in the second biome, like floaty lily pads or a subtle effect warning players about the reed’s sharp leaves ✨🔥


[h1][u]What happens next[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Preproduction of the third biome, including the boss (Gathering your on [url=https://discord.gg/qKGMmE3Ta4]Discord[/url])
[*] Continue working on HotJoin
[/list]

May your day be filled with cute paws—or pictures of them! 🐈‍⬛🐯🐶🦒🐸

notes.content:

notes.title: New Player Role & Lobby UI
notes.content:
Meow adventurers,

It’s time for a big new update!

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
The idea behind the balancing was to make the game easier for single players, as well as making the hard mode more achievable. As well as other things, we've tweaked the boss attacks so they don't deal as much damage as they used to.

[h2]New Player Role[/h2]
The new update provides you with a new role: The herbalist.
Use your staff to heal those in need - or to deal out a few whacks to anyone who comes too close.



[h2][u]Official Patchnotes 0.1.2.[/u][/h2]

[h3]New[/h3]

- Playable Herablist Role: Use your staff to heal allies in need – or to whack enemies who get too close!
- New Role Selection Menu in the Lobby: You now get additional information about each role before the match begins.
- A brand new skin is now available – unlock it by completing a new achievement!

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]

- The rings below the players and their emote ping now always retain their intended color and are no longer influenced by postprocessing.
- Attack telegraphs (the red shapes before you get damage) are no longer influsenced by postprocessing. That should improve the general readability.
- Increased the enemies pathfinding performance.

[h3]Balancing[/h3]

- Player health upgrades now increase your health by a percentage rather than a fixed value. The overall amount of health gained has also been increased.
- The ranged character now starts with less health instead of receiving reduced damage.
- There are now more trees and branches at the start of the game.
- The range for charging a totem has been increased.
- "Out in the cold" challenge is now worth 3 challenge badges.
- The prices for "Detect Loot", "Detect Weaknesses" and "Sixth Sense" have been increased.
- Guarded camps now have a smaller trigger area.

notes.title: DevLog March & April 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We've been working full speed on the new update for the last few weeks. It's all good to go live now, and it includes a new player role, a new lobby UI, and an improved enemy AI:


[h2][u]New Role[/u] 🌿[/h2]

Creating the new role meant we had to pick one of all your great suggestions, as well as deciding on a new weapon, new visuals to match their skills and more. The staff belongs to the herbalist. They can use herbs to charge their special skill and heal others 🌿 So, if your teammates are out in the dark fighting nasty badgers and urgently need some herbs, run over and use your special healing powers! 🪄And while you're at it, why not deal out a few whacks yourself?


[h2][u]Improve Enemy AI[/u] 🐇🦡[/h2]

To improve enemy behaviour and pathfinding, we're polishing their AI. This is also in preparation for future roles.     


[h3][u]Lobby UI[/u] 🖥️✨[/h3]

We reworked the lobby UI to better highlight the differences between roles, making it easier to see their abilities at a glance. The rework also makes finding your favourite skin a bit easier—though that part didn’t make it into the latest update just yet.


[h1][u]What Else We’ve Been Working On[/u][/h1]

[h2][u]Hot Join[/u] 🏜️[/h2]

We're still working on the HotJoin feature! Implementation is taking a bit longer as we need to account for all possible scenarios when someone joins a group. Plus, it needs to be built cleanly so we can reuse it for the savegame system later. But be reassured that this sought-after feature is already on the horizon 🤞


[h2][u]Next Biome: Frostbite Pass (Working Title)[/u] ❄️⛄🥶[/h2]

We've started reevaluating our initial concepts for Biome 3 🤩 A lot has changed since we first worked on them, and we've learned a great deal along the way. This time, we want to approach things differently: instead of designing the environment first, we started by creating the boss concept and will build the biome around it. What we do know for now is that Biome 3 will be a cold, high-altitude region — most likely set in the mountains 🏔️🌨️


[h2][u]More Languages[/u] 🗣️[/h2]

In order to make Wild Woods accessible to even more people, we are currently having it translated into more languages: Ukrainian, Italian, Turkish, Polish, Hungarian, Czech and Hindi.


[h1][u]What Happens Next[/u][/h1]

[list]
[*] Hotjoin as soon as it’s stable
[*] Implementing more languages
[*] Savegame (as soon as Hotjoin is ready)
[/list]

[h1][u]Why does new content take time?[/u] ⌛[/h1]

The main reason is that we are just three people. Each of us takes on multiple roles, which means it’s difficult to fix bugs and develop new content at the same time. When a critical issue arises, the  creation of new content inevitably has to slow down to ensure the game remains stable. This means we must carefully manage our limited resources.
We sincerely appreciate your support and understanding. Things might take some time, but we are excited and motivated to make Wild Woods the amazing game we all want it to be! 💚


[h1][u]Roadmap Update[/u] 🗺️[/h1]

We’ve just updated our roadmap! We’ve been listening to your feedback and hope the changes reflect your wishes and priorities. As always, the best way to share your thoughts is to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/qKGMmE3Ta4]Discord[/url] 🤗

[h2][u]Upgrade Shop Fixed[/u] 🛠️🕵️‍♂️[/h2]
Bug hunting can sometimes feel more like detective work than development, so let us take you behind the scenes of the player upgrade bug:
Some of you may have come across a bug where two of the three players' upgrades were swapped in camp. At first, we thought it was a client-side bug, possibly caused by a network problem. So we built a tool to test our theory. The result was: [b]Nothing[/b], according to the numbers, everything was working fine. So no way to reproduce the bug 🫤 A few test sessions later, however, we had a breakthrough 🥳 The bug only occurred for the host, and only in the second biome. More importantly, only the game's visuals were suspicious. With this information, the solution was quickly found. To make a visual change in the second biome, we wanted to mirror the player's upgrade shop. This was done by adding a “-” in front of a “1” in Unity. Best of all, the solution was implemented as soon as it was found: [b]Delete the minus[/b] 🚮
All in all, it took us several days to find the bug, but only a few minutes to implement the solution 😅

[h2][u]Bug Hunt[/u] 🔎🐞[/h2]
Thanks to your reports on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/qKGMmE3Ta4]Discord[/url], we’re able to reproduce a good number of bugs quite quickly. Others take a little longer to find and fix (see our story above).

notes.title: Happy Winter Holidays!
notes.content:
The first 2 weeks of our first ever game release - or rather its Early Access just happened and we are so flabbergasted, that we still kind of didn't realize it fully yet. It was a huge step for us – our debut in the world of game development!

Thank you so much for enjoying yourselves ingame and seemingly liking it :)

There is so much wholesome and constructive feedback coming in, amazing!
We tried hard to keep ourselves up-to-date with all you have been writing - but we are in the end only 3 active developers, which hopefully explains why some things are still unanswered at this point. Sorry for that, but none of your messages will be lost and we will come back to all of it at some point in the rather near future.


[h3]Community[/h3]
With the international release, we see so many new names on [url=https://discord.gg/qKGMmE3Ta4]Discord[/url] , people from all over the world join, sometimes just to say "Hi" <3

A very warm welcome to all of you! Thanks for joining :)

More people means also more teammates to group up, we are very happy that the "looking for group" area brings together new friends. It is really active these days, why don’t you check it out yourself?.


[h3]State of the Game[/h3]
We’re still newcomers to this field and have so much to learn, but we’re doing everything we can to deliver the best possible experience. Bugs are more likely to sneak into more complex systems like an online coop multiplayer game, so everything needs to be tested in different combinations of players, networks... this takes a lot of time.
There may be bumps along the way, and we kindly ask for your understanding as we grow and learn from your feedback, tackle challenges, fix bugs, and work hard to improve the game step by step.


[h3]Amount of Content[/h3]
The current content represents what we’ve been able to achieve as a small team of three. It’s a solid foundation that we’re proud of and one we can now build upon. With this groundwork in place, we’re ready to expand the game with more challenges, upgrades, and events. We have plenty of ideas, and this is just the beginning of what’s to come.

Our goal was to create a Rogue-like experience that’s accessible to beginners, whether you're playing with your younger brother or your mum – we wanted everyone to have fun. As a result, more complex and harder-to-explain mechanics took a backseat, and we decided to focus on what works best. The main priority was to create an enjoyable and accessible experience, ensuring that players of all levels could jump right in and have fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/1afb2208888fe6586fbc0eec3c39d8e9b479acfa.png[/img]

[h3]Meta Progression (or: Progression that stays unlocked)[/h3]
Currently, we’ve intentionally designed the game without meta progression beyond visual changes. One of the main reasons is to maintain balance in the multiplayer experience. We want to avoid situations where one player outpaces everyone else just because they has played the game for more hours, diminishing the fun for the rest of the group. Fairness and an enjoyable experience for everyone are our top priorities.

That said, we can imagine implementing systems where some kind of average value is calculated to prevent issues like this. This could allow for meta-progression without disrupting multiplayer balance. Nevertheless, this is something we need to explore further before making any decisions.

Therefore our current shortened Priority list for the near future looks like this:
[list]
[*]Technical: Stability, HotJoin, Session Browser, Checkpoints.
[*]Gameplay: Role, Events, Challenges & Upgrades
[/list]

But for now - after this exciting but justifiably draining release period and the first quick patches and fixes, we need to take a break for the winter holidays. The developers will be back in early January - but our Community Manager will be available from time to time (“oh, please note though, that I don't know how to fix bugs - those will have to wait until the devs are back”).

Get together with your loved ones in those cozy days and enjoy some Wild Woods (if you haven't got it yet, it's the perfect Christmas present *wink wink*).

Have a snowy Christmas and a happy New Year.

Octofox Games & Daedalic Entertainment

notes.title: DevLog April 2024
notes.content:
Miau, 🐈👋

We hope you enjoyed the last few days of the demo. As we explained, the last demo didn’t match the current game mechanics, so it was time to take it offline. Many of you were wondering what changed, so here’s our Monthly Dev Log, which explains the new challenge system and more:

[h1][u]What has happened since the last time[/u][/h1]

[h2]✨[u]New Challenge System[/u]✨[/h2]

As we mentioned in our last post, we have changed the challenge system. Our primary aim was to respond to feedback that crossroads could be overwhelming with information, and the frustration when you needed to choose a path due to the lack of resources. It’s a bit abstract if you haven’t played the new system, but we’ve tried to break it down:

When you enter a crossroads, you can still choose between two events (e.g. ambush, safe camp). Every path may include a challenge (e.g. stronger rabbit) which adds some difficulty. So why should you choose a path with a challenge? For every challenge you take, you will earn points, which can be [b]exchanged for rewards[/b] in the safe camp. Once you have traded them in at the safe camp, the challenges will end. For example, no more annoying rain disturbing your fire! 🙅‍♀️🌧️

As a result, we don't have to pay as much attention to how challenges influence each other and therefore are freer in the design of new ones. Therefore, more challenges for you to overcome! In addition, as challenges may end in the next safe camp, we can really go [b]wild[/b] with this: double the strength of enemies, invisible health bar, torrential rain, and so on.

[b]With a wide variety of challenges, every run you take becomes more different from the last one. In the long term, this influences the replay value of Wild Woods.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/5808d025194c16762defd888a1ca49a84287c1df.png[/img]

[h2][u]Performance improvements[/u]🎮[/h2]

We have improved the games performance. As a result, Wild Woods now runs at 60fps almost all the time, even on the Steam Deck 🥳

[h2][u]Second biome[/u]🌊[/h2]

Back in March, we gave you a sneak peek at the second biome. Even though it looks really nice, there are still some things missing. So we expanded the level and added a boss. Can you guess which animal the second boss might be?

[h2][u]More support for the team[/u]🤗[/h2]

Valeria from Osmotic Studio has joined our visual effects department. Among other things, she has been working on the visual effects of the totems. The additional visual effects should make the totem’s buff more obvious at first glance.

[h2][u]Emotes System[/u]😃👍🔥[/h2]

This was one of the most popular requests from the Playtest: a communication system. We already implemented the basic structure of an emote system, and now we need to polish the aesthetic. Do you have important emotes for communication in mind? 🤔

[h1][u]What happens next[/u][/h1]

[list]
    [*]Steam Achievements
    [*]Challenge system iterations
    [*]Update the tutorial with the new challenge system
    [*]Preparation of the next translations
    [*]Improve readability and comprehension of game mechanics
[/list]

[b]Last but not least, we'd love to hear your ideas for challenges[/b]. As mentioned before, you can [b]go wild[/b] with these. They can also be fun challenges (e.g. Rosie changing color every time you throw something in the wagon). Head over to [url=https://discord.gg/qKGMmE3Ta4]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts.

We look forward to your feedback on the new challenge system. It changes some of the gameplay, but we think it will make Wild Woods even better! 🔥💯🥳

We wish you a great start to the week 🥰😺

There are still bugs we have to fix, new ideas to implement and so much more work to do. Due to that, we decided to close the Playtest.

[h2]Thank you[/h2]

Thank you so much for the last couple of weeks! 💚💚
The Playtest was a great experience for us. What was definitely achieved thanks to you! As a thank you, we updated the emoji section on [url=https://discord.gg/GxvEX7Uc]Discord[/url] for you. Head over and look out for a blinking Rosie!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/82a9f45946950b7485ef8f6050cede5b731c8955.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/82a9f45946950b7485ef8f6050cede5b731c8955.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Team incomplete[/h2]

Unfortunately, one of our developers is unexpectedly absent for a longer period and we don’t know exactly when we will be back to full strength.
Because of this, we need more time than we initially planned. So please be patient if things take a bit more time than you might expect.
 
[h2]Demo[/h2]

In addition to organizing your feedback, we're also discussing potential improvements for Wild Woods, so that we can release a demo in the near future. That's also why our main priority right now is working on translations, bugs and overall stability.
To stay updated on the Demo news, join our [url=https://discord.gg/GxvEX7Uc]Discord[/url] and follow the announcement channel.


[b]Have a paw-some weekend with a lot of Wild Woods![/b] 🐈‍⬛🐾🎮

notes.title: DevLog September 2023
notes.content:
We're back, and we're whole again! :)

After some vacation time and thrilling adventures at various expos, our team is reunited and energized to continue our journey with you in Wild Woods! 

And special greetings from Eric ( @Bürgermeister on [url=discord.wildwoodsgame.com]Discord[/url]) who really enjoyed chatting with all of you who visited us at our booths.

[h1]What happened since the last time[/h1]

[h2]Deeper crossroad choices ⚔ <🪧> ⛈ [/h2] 
Remember that Crossroad System we've been teasing? Well, it's ready to roll!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/1aa52339f09cd3d939cc8a5d424c9839f636078b.png[/img]

Now, you can easily spot the added challenge, the available resources and the upcoming event that will accompany you until the next crossroads. No more surprises - just strategic decisions! Get ready to explore with confidence 🌟

The challenges are permanent until the end of the playthrough.

[h2]The charging boar 🐗 [/h2]
Joining our Wild Woods family is a fierce new addition - a wild boar! Players, take heed: when she charges your way, it's best to leap out of her path swiftly. And be aware to not let her charge against your wagon. Rosi won't be amused. 🐏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/9ed319da55902666d20d0e3715358b82764907b2.png[/img]

[h1]What happens next[/h1]
[list]
[*] Balancing
[list]
[*] the game with the new crossroad system
[*] for 1-4 players
[*] specific enemy squad combinations
[/list]
[*] Creating animation and logic for the 2. biome boss encounter.
[*] Creating still missing user interfaces.
[/list]
Now that our team is back at full strength, we're making significant strides towards the Beta phase. 🚀 Exciting times lie ahead in the world of Wild Woods, and we can't wait to share this adventure with you! Stay tuned for more updates and details on our upcoming Beta release.

All the best
Octofox Games

notes.title: DevLog August 2023
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow adventurers!

This is our first update post here on Steam. You can also find the older news here on [url=https://discord.wildwoodsgame.com/]Discord[/url]. Feel free to join our community there.

[h1]Gamescom & PAX West ! 🎮[/h1]
We're thrilled to be back at Gamescom this year, unfortunatly showcasing the trusty old demo that some of you may be familiar with. For those who haven't yet had the chance to experience it, the old demo will be also available on Steam for the duration of the Gamescom.

Right after Gamecom we will travel across the great ocean to partake in PAX too.

[h1]What happened since the last time[/h1]

[h2]Closed Beta this year 🍂❄ [/h2]
You've been asking us quite a bit lately about when Wild Woods will be released. Unfortunatly, in collaboration with our publisher, we've made a tough decision.

Wild Woods probably won't make its debut this year. But we're excited to announce that a closed Beta version will be dropping this year. More details are coming your way, so stay tuned!

[h2]The flying squirrel 🐿 [/h2]
Brace yourselves, because a new challenger has entered the woods – say hello to the mischievous Squirrel! This crafty critter glides down slowly and stealthily, snatching resources right from your wagon.

[table]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/67dfe15891d928e404dd438772ee65fc8c2d290d.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/d075782da1abd9817bca7d7bfa5a66293860ec61.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]VFX & telegraphs 💥[/h2]
Besides giving our first boss a makeover, fitting him perfectly into a custom-made arena, we've finally had the opportunity to contemplate the visual effects within the game and have now settled on a style that resonates with us. It strikes a balance between not being overly cartoony and overly realistic, a design approach we're eager to carry forward.

Furthermore we unified our, so-called attack telegraph system (the red circles you better leave quickly 😃 )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290044/1e9342345782690ced03a21dd15587252375d695.gif[/img]

[h1]What happens next[/h1]

While some us travel around the world with Wild Woods onboard, the remainder continue to work on the following:

- New enemies again 😃 
- Iteration on deeper crossroad choices
- 2. biome boss encounter
- Visual effects and balancing.

That's it, with the news, until next time!

All the best
Octofox Games
